dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're just lazing around, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, read the room.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Life is short but the flowers are lovely. There's no need to rush.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Take these. I hope it all goes well with you.
